User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the ZOOKA Studio system.

role.description: The role of the user (e.g., admin, supervisor, worker).

email.description: The email address of the user.

Site.title: Site
Site.description: Represents a cleaning site or location.

name.description: The name of the site (e.g., 'Villa Ahmed').

specialInstructions.description: Special instructions for cleaning the site.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client who owns the site.

contactEmail.description: The email address of the client.

contactPhone.description: The phone number of the client.

DailyReport.title: DailyReport
DailyReport.description: Represents a daily report created by a supervisor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the daily report.

workerIds.description: References to Users (Workers). (Relationship: User N:N DailyReport)

startTime.description: The starting time of the cleaning session.

endTime.description: The ending time of the cleaning session.

tasks.description: List of tasks completed in the daily report

additionalTasks.description: List of additional tasks completed in the daily report

clientSignature.description: URL or base64 representation of the client's signature.

supervisorSignature.description: URL or base64 representation of the supervisor's signature.

status.description: The status of the daily report (e.g., draft, in_progress, completed, approved).

totalCost.description: The total cost of the cleaning session.

WorkerTask.title: WorkerTask
WorkerTask.description: Represents tasks assigned to a worker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the worker task.

hours.description: Number of hours spent on the task.

name.description: The name of the task (e.g., 'Cleaning Floors').

description.description: A detailed description of the task.

name.description: The name of the material (e.g., 'Floor Cleaner').

description.description: A detailed description of the material.

Equipment.title: Equipment
Equipment.description: Represents a piece of equipment used for cleaning.

condition.description: The current condition of the equipment.

supervisor.description: The supervisor responsible for the equipment.

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: Represents a scheduled time for a site visit.

startTime.description: Start time of the scheduled visit

endTime.description: End time of the scheduled visit

supervisorId.description: Reference to User (Supervisor) assigned to the schedule.

workerIds.description: References to Users (Workers) assigned to the schedule. (Relationship: User N:N Schedule)

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Represents an audit log record for tracking modifications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log record.

userId.description: Reference to User who made the change.

entityType.description: The type of entity that was modified (e.g., DailyReport, Site).

entityId.description: The ID of the entity that was modified.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the change was made.

action.description: The action that was performed (e.g., create, update, delete).

oldValue.description: The value of the entity before the change (JSON string).

newValue.description: The value of the entity after the change (JSON string).

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the ZOOKA Studio application, focusing on role-based access, supervisor functionalities, and daily report management. The structure prioritizes authorization independence through denormalization and structural segregation to ensure secure and scalable operations. To facilitate a robust audit trail as requested, an `AuditLog` collection has been added to track modifications.

**Authorization Independence:**
To achieve authorization independence, key authorization data is denormalized. For example, the `Schedule` collection includes the `supervisorId` and `workerIds` to enable direct authorization checks without needing to fetch related user documents. This avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies and ensures atomic operations.

**Structural Segregation:**
The data structure segregates data based on access needs. User data is stored under `/users/{userId}`, ensuring private access. Daily reports are stored under `/dailyReports/{dailyReportId}`, and access is controlled based on the `supervisorId` and worker IDs associated with the report.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
To ensure secure list operations, the structure prevents mixing data with different access needs in the same collection. The path-based ownership for user data (`/users/{userId}/...`) and the use of denormalized authorization fields in other collections (e.g., `supervisorId` in `dailyReports`) enable efficient and secure filtering in security rules.

**Addressing User Stories:**

*   **Supervisor Dashboard:** The structure supports the Supervisor Dashboard by providing collections for `Schedules` and `DailyReports`, allowing the supervisor to efficiently manage appointments, tasks, and reports.
*   **Daily Report Wizard:** The `DailyReport` collection stores all the necessary information for daily reports, including site details, workers involved, tasks completed, materials used, and images. The structure also allows for the tracking of additional tasks and their costs.
*   **Audit Trail:** All modifications will now appear in the audit log, which can be reported to the admin. The inclusion of the audit log with `oldValue` and `newValue` supports the request of tracking changes made by workers to ensure transparency and accountability.
